verdict.note: Resend last_event is one field for the whole message (To + every Cc). A bounce on one Cc can hide a delivery to the others. A click is a human act and proves that mailbox received the mail. An open is a soft pixel and may be a proxy. EMAILED is API accept, not delivery.
